note: @copius.en's reel queue, read by .github/workflows/reels-instagram-en.yml at 18:00 Paris; the underscore keeps it off the site. An entry with "held" is never posted, by date or by id. To release one, on the owner's go: copy source video and cover to "file" and "cover", check each copy's sha256 against source (the files the Manager chat vetted), give it a "date", delete "held" and "source", commit both files with the entry. At most one reel a Paris day on the account.
